section_summary.extract_value: This section presents path analysis results testing whether early memories of warmth and safeness affect eating psychopathology severity through the mechanisms of self-compassion and body appreciation, while controlling for BMI and age. The final model demonstrated significant path coefficients with excellent fit, showing that body appreciation (measured with BAS-2) had a direct negative effect on eating disorder examination questionnaire (EDE-Q) scores, and that self-compassion and body appreciation partially mediated the relationship between early affiliative memories and disordered eating.
